metadata.brief: 用两个镜头说明：命中时从缓存返回数据；程序可能重复访问近期数据。图形为示意，不表示真实硬件尺寸或时延。
metadata.briefSource: Existing cache fixture in scripts/creative-loop-acceptance.ts; reused under the user instruction to continue P1.1, without a new human factual review.
metadata.scope: 12 seconds; 960x540; 30 fps; two shots; silent; public data-driven tools only.
metadata.controlledChallenge: Deliberately create one undersized explanatory text box, inspect it, then choose a repair from the returned diagnostics. This is a seeded challenge, not an unseeded model error.
humanInterventions: User authorized continuing P1.1 and merging after CI; no human edits during this trial.
metadata.decisionRecord: Concise action summaries supplied by the model, not private chain-of-thought.
metadata.attestation: Operator-recorded interaction with the current Codex session; not provider-signed evidence.

tools.name: animation.keyframes.set
tools.description: Create or replace a supported animation track on a project node.

tools.name: graphics.2d.chart.create
tools.description: Create a data-driven bar or line chart as a renderer-neutral Project Graph node.

tools.name: graphics.2d.path.create
tools.description: Create a safe structured SVG path node; raw SVG markup is not accepted.

tools.name: graphics.2d.shape.create
tools.description: Create a renderer-neutral 2D primitive in a scene.

tools.name: graphics.2d.text.create
tools.description: Create renderer-neutral text in a scene. Text content is project data, not generated TSX.

tools.name: inspect.layout
tools.description: Measure production browser text and element boxes after fonts load, without encoding screenshots or video. Reports text overflow, viewport crop and heuristic font fallback with node/frame identities. Occlusion, final pixels, exact glyph fonts and artistic quality are not checked.

tools.name: inspect.snapshot
tools.description: Inspect an immutable snapshot without encoding video. Returns model diagnostics, shape/chart bounds and exact sampled-frame coverage; browser text layout, final pixels, audio and content quality are not checked.

tools.name: project.create
tools.description: Create an empty canonical project bound to the current session; editorial content remains independent.

tools.name: project.inspect
tools.description: Read the session's project; no cross-project projectId argument is accepted.

tools.name: project.node.transform.set
tools.description: Set a node's 2D/3D transform through the canonical revisioned editing boundary.

tools.name: project.patch.apply
tools.description: Apply a revisioned non-removal Patch 1.1/1.2/1.3 batch. Removal requires the separately approved remove tool.

inputSchema.title: ScienceMotion Project Patch
inputSchema.$comment: Patch 1.1.0 preserves node operations; 1.2.0 adds asset operations; 1.3.0 adds scene, shot and animation editing. ProjectDocument remains 1.1.0. Keyframe validation is locally defined to keep the Patch schema self-contained.

tools.name: project.scene.create
tools.description: Create a scene and place it on a sequence through one revisioned Patch.

tools.name: project.snapshot.inspect
tools.description: Read a retained snapshot from this project; dependencies are pinned for the tool run.

tools.name: project.snapshot.save
tools.description: Retain the exact current revision and its local artifact dependencies.

tools.name: render.preview
tools.description: Render one frame from a project-owned immutable snapshot and return a retained PNG Artifact.

tools.name: render.video
tools.description: Render a bounded frame range from an immutable snapshot and return a retained MP4 Artifact.
